items.title: The Market May Be Underestimating This AI Chip-Design Stock
items.summary: Synopsys just posted explosive revenue growth that dwarfs its closest EDA rival, yet the market prices it at a fraction of that rival's multiple. Something in that gap tells a story most investors are missing.

items.title: How Much Upside is Left in Autodesk (ADSK)? Wall Street Analysts Think 25.32%
items.summary: The consensus price target hints at a 25.3% upside potential for Autodesk (ADSK). While empirical research shows that this sought-after metric is hardly effective, an upward trend in earnings estimate revisions could mean that the stock will witness an upside in the near term.

items.title: Adobe's Options Price A Year That Runs Past Its Own Range
items.summary: Adobe’s option-implied range runs from below anything the stock has traded at in the past year to far above its high, and that width is the real question for anyone who owns it.

items.title: Autodesk (ADSK) Q2 Beat Meets Softer Q3 Profit Outlook
items.summary: Autodesk (NasdaqGS:ADSK) reported Q2 earnings that came in above market expectations, with revenue also ahead of forecasts. The company issued a weaker profit outlook for Q3 than analysts had anticipated, which raised investor concerns about near term earnings momentum. This mix of stronger than expected recent results and softer guidance has affected sentiment toward the stock in recent trading. items.title: Autodesk (ADSK) Grew Revenue 16% but Remaining Performance Obligations Rose Only 2%
items.summary: Autodesk, Inc. (NASDAQ:ADSK) reported fiscal 2027 second-quarter revenue of $2.046 billion, up 16% year over year, while billings increased 10% to $1.854 billion. The obligations data presented a more complicated picture. Total remaining performance obligations, or RPO, rose only 2% to $7.433 billion.
